notes: Index fund tickers keep their last traded price across restarts (were snapping back to list price on boot; a boot-order bug skipped their persisted price). Chat history now persists across restarts and server resets (was memory only; added a bounded chat_log table, written per message, reloaded on boot, pruned to 200 per room). Added a Dev Logs tab: embedded Flesh Market News uploads, muted autoplay, loads on open and unloads on leave. Hard-refresh after deploy. DB adds a chat_log table on boot (additive, CREATE IF NOT EXISTS; starts empty). Carries 1.1.9.1 and earlier.
